steps.action: Block the destination IP at the firewall NOW to stop ongoing transfer.
Isolate the source host from the network to prevent further exfiltration.
Identify exactly what was transferred: file names, volumes, protocol used. Pull PCAP or proxy logs if available.
Determine how the threat actor got access to the source host — look for initial access vector (phishing, RCE, insider).
Notify legal and compliance teams. Determine if data is PII / regulated — breach notification obligations may apply.
Revoke credentials on the source host. Re-image if malware is suspected.
Deploy DLP controls on egress. Restrict large outbound transfers to approved cloud storage only.
Document data classification, volume, destination, and timeline. Preserve evidence for forensics.
